Lifeguard 'Harries' plans to propose to girlfriend Emily high above Bondi in a chopper, and needs the team to make a huge 'Marry Me' sign in the sand. But in the lead up Kerrbox throws a spanner in the works, putting blue paint in Harries' spray tan.

2016 dawns on Bondi with drug and alcohol-affected masses taking lifeguards to another level. A 300-person-strong Dutch contingent raises the stakes even further. Nicola loses her cool with beachgoers, and Singlets and Mario lose their cool with each other.

Christmas crowds at Bondi overwhelm lifeguards. Caught between minor rescues and serious situations, Maxi makes a wrong decision. Jake struggles with numerous rescues on the jetski. Jackson rushes through the crowd to save a drunk woman in a rip, earning a surprising Christmas kiss.

Jesse responds to a report of a man falling from cliffs. The situation takes a tragic twist when the police chopper arrives. A thick fog makes it impossible to see swimmers in the water. Harries introduces new technology to the rescue service, but not everyone is convinced by the product.

In the chaos of massive waves at Bondi's north corner, a bodyboarder in his 70s gets sucked out, and it's up to ex-pro surfer and Bondi's only female lifeguard, Nicola Atherton, to attempt the most dangerous rescue of her career. Additionally, a tragic spinal injury leaves the lifeguards in shock.

Lifeguards search for a couple who have been washed off rocks by a large wave. Joel rescues a family of four in the flagged area. Lifeguards compete in a fast-paced race in big swells. Seeking an edge, Joel, Jules, and Jethro undergo secret training with professional Iron Men and Women.

Singlets returns to work, performing his first rescue since the tragic drowning of a Norwegian man. Pierre from Hong Kong fulfills a dream by visiting the tower after saving all his money to meet the Bondi Rescue lifeguards. Hoppo imparts valuable lessons to kids on surviving in a rip.

Cyclonic swell hits Bondi Beach with 12-foot waves, posing a significant challenge for Harries during a board rescue off Ben Buckler. In addition to the man in danger, H intervenes to lecture drunken youths burying beer bottles in the sand. New drone life vest technology is tested at Bondi Beach.

Bondi reopens after its first closure since World War II. A paraglider crashes into the water, prompting a lifeguard rescue. Mario attempts to fix the lifeguard buggy. New lifeguard Max performs his first rescue. Bondi lifeguards bond and celebrate milestones in the tower.

500 Dutch tourists storm into the surf to celebrate New Year's Day. On the promenade Singlets treats a rollerblader with a severely dislocated knee. And American Superstar Comedian, Conan O'Brien, tries his hand at lifeguarding - with hilarious results.
Kite surfers make the most of the wild conditions when the biggest storm of the season hits Bondi. Chappo and Jack race to help a man with agonising chest pains, and Harries confronts a body surfer.

As department heads at Sejung Hospital clamor to have Sunwoo admitted to their own units, the residents are left confused and overwhelmed. A new notice is issued declaring that all surgical cases must be handled by the on-call surgeon, and Euna watches with concern as Inhyuk exits the operating room.

After Inhyuk completes the surgery, both sides scramble to prepare for an impending disciplinary hearing—the ER staff on one side, and the department heads on the other, each holding urgent strategy meetings. Meanwhile, when the guardian of a patient complaining of abdominal pain aggressively demands discharge, Minwoo allows the patient to leave.

When the surgery schedule for a high school girl injured in a traffic accident falls into chaos, everyone can't help but miss Choi Inhyuk's presence, while Minwoo sinks into self-doubt. Meanwhile, a clue surfaces about the whereabouts of a patient discharged with suspected bowel perforation, and Jaein stands her ground without hesitation—even in the face of threats from gangsters.

Thanks to Jaein and Minwoo, Jiyoung undergoes surgery successfully and later posts a heartfelt message of gratitude on the hospital website, earning Minwoo recognition as a “Kindness Award” staff member. Meanwhile, Inhyuk, who has submitted his resignation and begun searching for a new job, witnesses another traffic accident unfold right before his eyes.

When Sunwoo, currently hospitalized in the ICU, is scheduled for surgery, Minwoo struggles with how to break the news to Jaein. At the same time, a reporter named Kyungho arrives at the ER to investigate, publishing an article about Hansoo, who is hospitalized there—instantly thrusting the hospital into the media spotlight.

A middle-aged man feigns illness and behaves inappropriately toward Jaein, leaving her deeply uncomfortable, but Minwoo steps in to defuse the situation and comfort her. Elsewhere, Minjun confidently enters the operating room, only to find that Wonguk's condition is far more critical than expected—leaving him powerless to intervene.
Samjae ends up working at WINNERS and Seoyeong at Unique. She's shocked by seeing Yeonhui and Seonu but doesn't say a word to Ujae about it. Hojeong declares war on Migyeong for Sangu.

Jiseon can't handle the fact that her son and daughter-in-law are so close even after a fight. Seoyeong gets angry and jealous at Ujae now and he couldn't be happier. Meanwhile Seonu continues to drive delve into Seoyeong's life for a weakness and Minseok continues on with his midlife crisis.

Seoyeong runs into Sangu at the hospital dropping her phone and getting injured. Ujae panics at the news and goes looking for her. Meanwhile the battle for Ujae is surging on as Migyeong allow Hojeong to try what she would to get Sangu. In the end Samjae ends up having a drink with Ujae and Ujae asks him to tell him about his life.

Migyeong can't stand not telling the truth anymore and finally organizes the time to confess to Sangu with the help of her brother. Meanwhile Seoyeong finds out that she'll be in-laws with Sangu's hospital and takes drastic measures to once again try and ensure her happiness whilst Director Choi anxiously awaits his fate with the company.

Migyeong finally ends up confessing the truth to Sangu with unexpected results. Seongjae continues to work hard with the Seoyeong doppelganger and tensions continue to rise at Unique law firm. Plus Minseok continues to be backed into a corner by work and wife.

Sangu is stressing about what to do with Migyeong. Minseok hands in his resignation and is freed of being a WINNERS director. Seonu keeps trying to get into Seoyeong's head by working on Yeonhui and Ujae and Sangu asks to meet Seoyeong in the end.
Lee Soon appoints Maid Choi to the fourth rank concubine. Meanwhile, Prince Dongpyeong confesses to Lee Soon that he loved Ok Jung.

Lee Soon, at Jang Hyeon's request to hold an interrogation, tells him to keep his mouth shut in exchange for making him his father-in-law. Meanwhile, the fourth concubine drinks poisoned rice punch and falls unconscious.

Ok Jung, when Yun falls ill with smallpox, goes to see a shaman with her mother Lady Yoon. Meanwhile, Concubine Choi seeks out the palace office, saying she has an accusation against Ok Jung to announce in front of Lee Soon and the ministers.
Lee Soon gives a decree to Ok Jung for the crimes of setting up an altar and harboring jealousy towards Inhyeon. Meanwhile, Chi Soo asks Ok Jung to be given to him as property.

Yeonwoo, the daughter of the Chief Scholar of Hongmungwan, enters the palace to attend the celebratory banquet honoring her brother's success in the civil service examination. At the same time, Crown Prince Hwon vaults over the wall of Eunwol Pavilion—only to run straight into Yeonwoo. Mistaking him for a thief, Yeonwoo confronts Hwon, but upon noticing the handkerchief he gives her, she realizes he is none other than the Crown Prince.

Yeom, the son of the Chief Scholar, is a man of irresistible charm who, after placing first in the state examination, is appointed as the Crown Prince's tutor. Displeased with his young teacher, Hwon engages in a tense battle of wits with Yeom—unaware that he is Yeonwoo's brother.
Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

During a routine prison work detail, convict Piper (Laurence Fishburne) is chained to Dodge (Stephen Baldwin), a cyberhacker, when gunfire breaks out. Apparently, the attack is related to stolen money that the Mafia is after, and some computer files that somebody wants desperately to bury. The pair, who don't exactly enjoy each other's company, escape and must work together if they are to reach Atlanta alive. Luckily, they meet a woman (Salma Hayek) who may be willing to help them.

The Hound of Hell (Snoop Dogg) is a guide through three stories from a neighborhood of depraved citizens. Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programmes.st: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
programmes.d: Blueberry has become obsessed with the mystery book detective heroine, Patti Persimmon. She decorates her store with Patti posters and rearranges her shelves to make room for all the Patti books she's ordered. Blueberry begins to neglect outings with her friends and even goes so far as to dress like her idol just to emulate her. She then starts looking for cases to solve around town.

While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!
Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

While sipping cider in Strawberry's café, the girls muse about how they cannot wait for winter to arrive. They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables  his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

programmes.d: The Bluffscout canoe trip runs into trouble when Scoutmaster Dink heads off to fix his broken computer, leaving Roger in charge. Just when Doug has persuaded The Beets to play a concert at school, Mr. Bone nixes the deal.

programmes.d: Odiferous Krumm, who put the stink in distinct, loses his stench and fears his monstering days are over.  A Hollywood director mistakes Krumm for an extra on his movie set, and turns him into a star.

programmes.st: Monster Makeover/Airplane, a Wing and a Scare
programmes.d: Wanting a face only a monster could love, Ickis contemplates plastic surgery.  Ickis, Krumm, and Oblina get folded and spindled when they get themselves trapped in a suitcase and are loaded onto a plane bound for Wisconsin.

Sam comes in after a bad date.  Clarissa tells him he just hasn't found the right "one" yet.  As they list the qualities of the perfect girl for Sam, it occurs to him that the perfect girl is...Clarissa!
Kimi becomes obsessed with her Japanese heritage when she and the gang have to research their family trees as a school project.

Angelica's been invited to Savannah's party so she has to find a dress that hasn't ABW (Already Been Worn). While working at the hospital she suddenly breaks her nose and fakes a dilemma. Meanwhile the other kids are doing community service.
Susie is forced to choose between singing success in a TV talent show and leading her language team to victory in the language bowl, which is held on the same day.

When Chuckie's biggest competition for School Safety Commissioner is Dil's imaginary alien friend, Izzy, you would think he would have it in the bag. But when Izzy becomes more popular than Chuckie, can he rely on his friends to help him win?

Stu becomes a little too helpful when he helps Tommy with his science fair project. Meanwhile, Lil works with Kimi on their project. But Lil would rather work with Nicholas, a purple-haired cutie who isn't very smart.
Angelica tries to help Chuckie become more popular as a school project, but it backfires when he takes her advice, and he becomes more popular than her.
On a trip to a mountain resort, Tommy develops his first crush on a girl named Olivia.

When Susie gets a gig singing at Slosh Mountain, the world's coolest water park, she gives free tickets to all the Rats. The kids are thrilled, not so much about the show, but about getting the chance to go on the mother of all rides, Whiplash Gorge.

The whole school has caught Yu-Gotta-Go fever... except Chuckie. When he finally starts playing, it becomes an obsession. He becomes one of the school's best players, but in the heat of the game, he almost loses a precious gift.
Determined to get more involved with the recording process the boys compete to write a new song for BTR.

Kendall and Jo help Carlos find a date, and Logan flirts with a new girl while still confused about his feelings for Camille. James wants to help Katie get closer to her new crush, but becomes like an overprotective father.
Gustavo starts an all-girl pop group, sparking jealousy from the guys.

The guys get to hang out at Griffin’s beach house for day and invite the Palm Woods kids along. Carlos and Logan hunt for buried treasure, and James falls for a pretty girl who he suspects is a mermaid.

Griffin films the guys' lives for a reality show.
After meeting Susan, Drake's new girlfriend, Josh becomes convinced that her flirtation is more than friendly behavior.
When Mr. Nichols boss calls off their dinner plans because of a last minute babysitter cancellation, Josh volunteers his and Drake's services.
After Drake agrees to help Josh with his girl troubles, Josh finds himself promising to play a birthday song at his crush's party.
When the parents leave town for the weekend, Drake and Josh's excitement is stunted when they learn that Grammy is coming to stay.
Drake bets that he can last longer without junk food than Josh can without video games. Who will win.
Drake receives tickets to a concert and a guitar autographed by his idol. Josh accidentally destroys the guitar and to cover it up has to buy a new one.

True and Lulu try to sneak out of the office to get B.o.B tickets. True then agrees to let her Uncle Troy's girl soccer team have a birthday party at Mad Style. Meanwhile, Ryan, Jimmy and Max spend the day at a comic book store in New Jersey.

The kids go to Colonial Town for their school field trip and True learns about Lovers Tower, the town's clock tower, where it's said that when two lovers kiss at the stroke of one they will be together for eternity.

During a science experiment gone wrong Ryan accidently injures Principal Ruckman and becomes the temporary Principal.  Quickly Ryan's new position goes to his head and he becomes a power crazed Principal.
True and Lulu help open a Mad Style store at the mall, where they meet a number of interesting characters.
True is slammed with work and in order to liven things up Mr. Madigan takes True and Lulu to fulfill his annual ritual of granting a stranger's wish when they throw a coin into the mall's fountain.
Who Loves Orange Soda?: Kenan bets Kel that he can't give up drinking orange soda for one week.

programmes.st: I Haven't Got Time For the Paint
programmes.d: I Haven't Got Time For the Paint: Kel demonstrates a talent for painting and Kenan quickly plots to exploit it at an art auction.
A Star Is Peeved: Kenan and Kel are determined to be in a movie that is being filmed at Rigby's.

Ditch Day Afternoon: Kenan and Kel decide to skip a day of school and work.  They call in sick, but soon find themselves in big trouble when they get caught in a bank robbery and end up on the national news.
James' mom, nicknamed the "Estee Lauder of the Midwest" for her successful cosmetics line, arrives at the Palm Woods to bring James home and groom him to take over the family company.
Kendall and Jo confront the future of their relationship when she lands her dream role in a movie blockbuster that will film overseas for the next three years.

Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

The year is 1972, and Betsy Jobs and Arlene Lorenzo just want to have a good time. But during a class field trip to the White House, they cluelessly wander into a behind-closed-doors, top-secret shredding session. Rating: PG-13

Andromeda answers a distress call when a cargo ship is attacked. Meanwhile, Trance is interrogated after paying a visit to the people.

programmes.st: Last Call at the Broken Hammer
programmes.d: The crew looks for a long-lost Commonwealth leader who has gone into hiding. They find her, but one question remains: is it actually her?

The crew is separated: Dylan, Beka, and Trance go with Rommie to find out about a new weapon being developed on a planet that is distrustful of AI; Harper, Tyr, and Rev struggle for survival when the Maru crashes into the ocean.
Andromeda is tasked with escorting medical ships safely through Drago-Kazov space.
A planet of Commonwealth survivors, led by Dylan's former fiance, is invited to join the new Commonwealth, but when they vote not to join, the Magog are suspected of playing dirty.
An agent of the Abyss tries to lure Harper into joining the Magog.
When they rescue a young prince from an uprising that kills the rest of his family, Dylan and Tyr are asked to be his advisers.
Dylan and his new Commonwealth fleet take on the Drago-Kazov fleet but find it much larger than he expected.
The Magog eggs in Harper are starting to hatch, so the team builds a Tesseract Machine. After unintended time shifts, Trance is replaced by her future self.
Dylan takes over a tourist barge in an attempt to escape mercenaries.
A body identification goes awry when it turns out Beka's former crewmate isn't dead at all.
Andromeda rescues dying people from a drift, but they soon turn into zombies being controlled by a hive-mind.
The Engine of Creation is capable of rewriting the universe according to the owner's wishes. Dylan, Beka, and Trance must obtain it before someone with dark plans gets it.
A black hole knocks out Dylan and sends him into an alternative reality with a wife and child.
The crew rescues one of the long-lost founders of the Commonwealth, but discover she may be more trouble than she is worth.
A mythological space monster tries to eat the Andromeda.

programmes.st: The Knight, Death, and the Devil
programmes.d: Dylan attempts to liberate a fleet of captured ships who aren't sure they want to be liberated. Their AIs fear new captains will enslave them.

programmes.t: Go Nagai's The Devil Lady: Enemy
programmes.d: Jun is introduced to Dr. Jason Bates who professes his interest in her, both as a woman and as Devil Lady.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Dark Knights
programmes.d: Terror follows Jonathan and his fellow travelers to Windknight’s Lot, where they find themselves faced with the devious Dio. The onslaught of evil continues with two colossal knights.
Just as Jonathan’s heroism transforms one foe’s hatred into humanity, an even greater behemoth drives the crew to a knightly training camp, complete with a medieval chamber of death.

Conquering his own fear, an unlikely star opens an opportunity for Zeppeli and Jonathan. But as a prophecy from Zeppeli’s past unfolds dramatically in a clash of life, death, and succession, a true hero triumphs.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bloody Battle! JoJo & Dio
programmes.d: With sword in hand and a team of Hamon masters at his side, Jonathan sets out to save Poco’s sister. When one slithery demon makes its move, Jonathan steps in, igniting an all-out war with his “brother.”

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Final Ripple!
programmes.d: Jonathan takes Erina’s hand in marriage before embarking on a celebratory journey to America. But two stowaways unwittingly change the course of history for all those onboard.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: New York's JoJo
programmes.d: It’s 1938, and hotheaded Londoner Joseph and his grandmother, Erina, have arrived in New York, where he wastes no time brandishing his innate tendencies—especially when he learns of Speedwagon’s expedition.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Game Master
programmes.d: Bullets fly and Hamon reverberates as brassy Joseph battles the Hamon master-turned-vampire Straizo. Later, an ominous revelation pulls Joseph to Mexico.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Pillar Man
programmes.d: In search of the mysterious Pillar Man, Joseph arrives in Mexico to promising news but deadly resistance. Now the German army’s thirst for power may have awakened an unstoppable power—even for Joseph.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: JoJo vs. The Ultimate Lifeform
programmes.d: Trading blows with Santviento, Joseph employs his usual wit, but the jokes fall as flat as the Hamon. Stroheim surprises as he sheds light on the lethal Pillar Men, leaving Joseph hanging in more ways than one.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Ultimate Warriors from Ancient Times
programmes.d: Joseph and Speedwagon travel to Rome to meet another Hamon wielder, Caesar Zeppeli, who takes them to the enigmatic Pillar Men. While Joseph and Caesar clash, they arrive to find a grim awakening.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: A Hero's Proof
programmes.d: Caesar confronts Wamuu and the other Pillar Men, but falters, clearing the way for Joseph. But anxiety replaces audacity as Joseph’s plan invites a presumable death sentence.
In mysterious Venice, Joseph and Caesar begin training under the equally enigmatic Lisa Lisa. Let the Hamon “hell” begin!
Under Lisa Lisa’s tutelage, Joseph and Caesar must endure their final test. But while Caesar hones his skills, Joseph is stunned by an ancient and unexpected foe.
Joseph returns to Lisa Lisa, unaware of the bizarre stowaway he has delivered. A possessed confidant then attacks, ultimately sending the crew to Switzerland, where another revelation awaits.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: A Race Toward the Brink
programmes.d: Stroheim is back from the brink, now as a cyborg designed to secure the great Red Stone. Kars, however, is not willing to concede and wages war, even as the stone hurtles toward an alpine cliff.
Lisa Lisa paints a picture of honor when she reveals Caesar’s tragic past to Joseph. Meanwhile, in the face of certain danger, Caesar enters into a solitary battle to avenge his father.
Though he's been doing the hero gig for three years, Saitama realizes that the public knows nothing about him.
It's been five days since Saitama became a professional hero, and he has yet to do anything heroic.
An enormous meteor hurtles toward City Z. Genos decides it's up to him to protect the home of his master and stop the meteor, no matter what the cost.
A pack of monsters calling themselves the "Clan of the Seafolk" arrives on the shores of City J, intent on invading the land.
Yuki has a lot on her mind after almost being kissed by Zero. She asserts that she will not speak to Kaname until he admits to Zero’s innocence.
The Night Class goes to the Aido family’s vacation home during the long break, but Hanabusa decides to stay at the academy because he suspects Kaname had something to do with Shizuka’s death.
Yuki, driven by her desire to stop hurting Zero, tries to regain her memory of the past and becomes haunted by even more powerful visions.
Yuki is continually haunted by visions of blood. Nevertheless, she is determined to find out about her past from Kaname, but he repeatedly evades her question.
Higuchi is captured and tells the investigators about the Death Note.
Light, his memory recovered, orders Misa to begin killing after Higuchi dies.
Light has removed everyone in his way and is closer to achieving his perfect world.
A new investigator steps forward, Near, a central figure in the SPK, an organization that is trying to catch Kira without relying on L.
Light, acting as L, reveals to Near that his sister Sayu has been kidnapped by someone wanting to trade her for the Death Note.
Light tries to discover where Mello and his Mafia associates are hiding and uses Misa's eyes to find the Death Note's current owner.
Three girls, Ibara Naruse, Aoi Fukasaku, and Taeko Nomura, arrive in the ruins of the Old Capital, which was destroyed in an accident decades ago.

Natasha Raskin Sharp and James Braxton are in the Black Country. James finds an enormous specimen of a rather famous bird and a noisy antique. Natasha gets her hands on a rather macabre little curio and goes gaga for some ceramics.

Natasha Raskin Sharp and James Braxton head to Lancashire and the Lake District. Natasha eyes some more brooches. James takes a fancy to some sizable and suitably heavy items, but a big spend leaves him a little light in the pocket.

Scotland is Natasha Raskin Sharp and James Braxton's final stop. James is drawn to big and colorful items, while Natasha has an eye for the unusual, with one item conjuring up a memory of her grandfather and another reminding her of James.

Hettie Jago and Tim Medhurst have a replica Jaguar for their shopping trip which begins in sunny Sussex. Tim uncovers an unusual teapot, possibly by William Hutton. Hettie's interest is piqued by an Art Deco figurine of a mouse.

programmes.st: If You Go Down to the Woods Today…
programmes.d: Deep into Surrey, England's most wooded county, Tim Medhurst buys a plaster bust and some salt glazed Toby jugs. Hettie Jago, meanwhile, picks up an Italian gilt box and an elegant brass dancing figure.

Grissom and Sara are called to the crime scene when two murder victims are found hidden in pipes at a construction site in the middle of an alfalfa field, while Catherine and Nick investigate an ostensible hunting accident.

Grissom investigates the murder of a Las Vegas photographer whose remains were dumped at a nearby body farm.

A bus carrying 23 passengers from Los Angeles to Las Vegas crashes less than 40 miles from its destination, killing nine people.
Jane Galloway is a nervous breakdown waiting to happen. She has completely shielded herself from the outside world, but that doesn't stop a stalker in her attic from killing her.
Grissom and Catherine investigate the stabbing death of an 80-year-old woman who lived in a run-down house full of cats.
Grissom and Sara investigate when a man's body, which has been doused with lye, is found buried in a park.
Grissom and his crew handle their highest profile case to date when the city's former chief of detectives is slain execution-style in his house following a wild party.
The CSIs investigate when the body of an unidentified young woman is discovered stuffed in an overturned shopping cart near a freeway underpass.
Gil Grissom is the supervisor of the graveyard shift of Las Vegas' elite crime scene investigators. Holly Gribbs, fresh out of the academy, joins the team.
A man is killed after winning a fortune and then dumping his girlfriend. So, Grissom, Nick, and newcomer to the CSI team, Sara Sidle, investigate this one.
Grissom, Nick, and Sara search for a kidnapped woman and find more than they expected. Catherine and Warrick investigate the hit-and-run death of a little girl.
Grissom and Catherine investigate when a leg is found severed from a body in a lake. Meanwhile, Sara and Nick investigate a fraternity pledging gone terribly wrong.
The CSI team is hard-pressed to find the killer of an infamous drug lord, and a member of the team is investigated for drugs by Internal Affairs.
A rapist is brutally murdered after his identity is exposed.  Horatio and the CSI team are called in to investigate the murder.
Horatio and the CSI team investigate a group of male “pickup artists” out to score when one of them unexpectedly turns up dead.
Miami’s Latin Festival shifts from Samba to somber when a crowded dance floor becomes the scene of a gang member.  Horatio and the team investigate.
A bizarre murder of a South Beach club owner turns out to be a script where art is imitating life.  Horatio and the CSI team investigate.
Horatio’s longtime criminal nemesis Walter Resden surfaces once again, and Caine is determined to finally bring him to justice.
Alex campaigns against a sex offender who moves into her neighborhood and then becomes embroiled in controversy when the man is murdered soon thereafter.
What begins as a case of apparent Road Rage leads the CSI team to the investigation of a stolen $4 million necklace, which is tied to a murder.
When a white supremacist is acquitted for the murder of his wife after learning she is racially mixed, it’s up to Horatio to bring the killer down.
A band of masked gunmen invade an upscale spa, with the female customers' luxury cars as their booty. A customer is injured in the melee.
The bodies of two men, shot execution-style, are discovered in an abandoned hotel slated for demolition. Horatio and the CSI team investigate.
A cell phone call leads the team to investigate a kidnapping that, unless they reach the victim before it’s too late, could soon become a murder.
A young, ultra-glam heiress and media darling is found electrocuted in her bathtub during a party, and there is no shortage of suspects.
While investigating the disappearance of a cruise ship passenger, the team discovers that a murder has also taken place on the ship.
The CSI Team is on high alert when the deadly Mala Noche gang initiates a shooting rampage during the trial of one of their members.
Horatio’s search for Antonio Riaz continues. The Feds take over the lab and investigate each team member when $12,000 is missing from a drug bust.
The CSI team suffers the tragic loss of one of their own when a psychotic genius runs wild in otherwise beautiful Miami.
A patient from a mental hospital, who masquerades as Superman, is found dead in an alleyway The CSIs retrace his steps to restore justice to the city.
When an anonymous caller tells Mac there is a dead body buried at Giant’s Stadium, evidence found at the scene points to one of the CSIs.
The team investigates the murder of a limo driver at a Kid Rock concert. With Kid as a leading suspect, the CSIs find themselves backstage.
A young woman, dressed as a mermaid, is discovered floating in a bed of kelp.  The CSIs search Manhattan for her murderer.
A marine is found dead in Central Park. Across town, the team investigates the death of a woman found in a burned out car.
When a security guard is stabbed to death, Mac and Flack rush to the scene. While investigating the murder, a bomb is detonated.
When two bungee jumpers witness a death on the Brooklyn Bridge, Mac and his new love interest Peyton Driscoll are called in to investigate.
When Holly Golightly look-alikes rob a jewelry store the detectives find themselves questioning the girls’ involvement in the world of blood diamonds.
Danny and Lindsay investigate the death of a vodka spokeswoman dressed as an ice queen, and murdered with her scepter at a promotional event.
A serial murderer leaves his victims in coded t-shirts. The team struggles to decode his mythological clues and put their main suspect behind bars.
Danny and Lindsay explore the worlds of goth and glam when a young girl that belongs to the underground “suicide girls” cult is found dead.
A young hotel employee falls to her death from a hotel rooftop after she becomes embroiled in a deal with a scheming top model.
Mac is summoned from a night at the opera to a bloody crime scene. Across town, a famous bachelor is found dead in his swim gym.
When a paintball player is found shot to death, Flack realizes that a dirty cop under his supervision could be to blame.

A follow-up on the Hurricane Katrina dogs Cesar took; a German shepherd mix is difficult to walk; a chocolate lab refuses to walk on her family's new hardwood floors.
A dog develops an aggression problem after moving to a new area; a big dog does not let people near her owner; a beagle sniffs continually.
A family deals with a stray dog who bites; Daisy Fuentes has trouble controlling her English bulldog.
A dog barks all the time and might pose a threat to children; a beagle mix has lots of strange behaviors.
A herding dog likes to bite the noses of horses; a family struggles with a dog who runs out the door as soon as it is opened.
Cesar helps Lucy, an odd Dalmatian who is affectionate one minute and angry the next and Lizzie who is obsessed with running all the time.
Cesar has his hands full with a Labrador that is obsessed with water and a Chihuahua with a penchant for biting legs.
A human psychologist calls Cesar for help when her pet pug and pet pig fight; an emotionally scarred German shepherd.
A dog with a dark side has a knack for stalking and killing small animals; a poodle chases cars; a bulldog has an adverse reaction to skateboarders.
A rescued dog is too ferocious; an insane Great Dane upsets a household; playing matchmaker for a lonely but picky boxer.
Pets abandoned during Hurricane Katrina reunite with their owners or find new homes; a pit bull behaves aggressively toward the dog of his owner's new girlfriend; a large dog has pica.
Dora, Boots, and Abuela are exploring the rainforest looking for the secret door to Adventure Forest! It's a magical forest amusement park that Abuela used to go to when she was a little girl!
Dora is reading a book of nursery rhymes to Abuela's kitty, Lucky. Lucky loves the one about the three little kittens who ring the bells on their mittens as they dance and sing!
Dora and Boots put on their roller skates and take off on a skating adventure to stand up to a bully named Big Wheeler and open the Skate Park for everyone.
After helping Sparky the horse feel better, Dora goes on one more ride with him before bringing him back to the barn.
Dora takes a magic cape back to the prince's castle so she can break the spell that turned the prince into a lion.
Dora and Boots return to the Snowy Forest to help the Snow Princess defeat the Ice Witch in a skating contest and win back everyone's ice skates.
It's time for the Rainforest Talent Show, but first Dora and Boots have to rescue Benny so he can tell his jokes in the show.

programmes.st: Dora and Diego in the Time of Dinosaurs
programmes.d: Dora and Diego travel back to prehistoric times and go on a dinosaur adventure to find Baby Jaguar and bring him home to his birthday party.

programmes.st: Dora and the Very Sleepy Bear
programmes.d: Dora and Boots try to keep a very sleepy Baby Bear awake long enough to get her home for her winter nap.
Dora, Emma, and Kate help Gus the bus take all of the instruments to the kids at music school.
Dora and Boots need to help the Fairy Godmother fix her magic wand, so she can get her puppy back!
Dora, Boots, and Diego set out to rescue their bunny, turtle and butterfly animalito friends and bring them back home to their Copal Tree.
Dora and Boots rush to take Dora's Night Light to the Library before it gets too dark for the little chickens' special story time.
Dora and Boots journey deep into the Never-to-be-Seen-Again Forest so they can bring magic water back from Sparkling Lake and save the magic in Fairytale Land.
Dora and Boots read about a chicken that's as big as a house and set off to meet him.
Dora and Boots find a little baby blue bird who fell out of her nest.
What's that funny sound coming from Yellow Valley? Dora and Boots set off to investigate.
Dora brings Boots a special present, a new floaty that will help him swim. Boots is thrilled, and they set off for the beach.
Deedle dee dee! Dora and Boots hear the ice cream truck nearby, but they just miss it.
All aboard! It's time for the big train race. The first train to the Big Yellow Station wins a big whistle.
Dora and Boots find a blue key; it turns out it's the key to a big treasure chest.
Dora and Boots are at the farm today, bringing presents to the three little piggies.
Boots loses one of his shiny red boots in the Big River. Dora and Boots set off on a wild water adventure as they chase the runaway boot.
Dora and Boots go hunting for blueberries on Blueberry Hill. But they'll have to be careful—Swiper the fox lives on Blueberry Hill!
Dora and Boots meet Wizzle, who lost his bag of wishes and can't get home. Our heroes, Dora and Boots, set off in search of the lost wishes.
Dora and Boots set off to deliver a basket of treats to Dora's Abuela to help her with her cold. Dora's mother warns her to watch out for Swiper the Fox. He'll swipe the treats.
It's Boots' birthday! Dora tells him that all his friends are waiting at her house to give Boots a big party.
Benny the Bull needs some sticky tape in a hurry. His hot air balloon is leaking and floating toward Crocodile Lake! Dora and Boots rush off to rescue their friend.
Boots buys a super blue bouncy ball at the store, but it bounces off down the hill.
Dora remembers the first time she met her friend Backpack. Backpack is helping Dora carry her books back to the library. Can they reach the library before it closes?
Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.
Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.
Dora and Boots are getting ready to make a wish on the first star in the sky when the star falls! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring Little Star back home to the Moon.
Matthew decides to run for sheriff after Colorado Springs is hit by a crime wave.
Matthew, the new town sheriff, falls in love with the wrong kind of woman.
The residents of Colorado Springs are suckered into a financing scam.
Sully leads the rescue when a boy is kidnapped by a mountain man; Dr. Mike's pregnancy is in danger when she does not take care of herself.
Sully leaves the unruly rescue party to hunt for Matthew on his own; Dr. Mike's least favorite physician takes over her practice.
When the Rev. Johnson finds that his former mentor plans a visit, he borrows money from Hank to fix up his ramshackle church.
Emotions run high when a drifter is convicted of rape and murder.
The opening of a school on the Indian reservation becomes the subject of bitter controversy.
Dr. Mike’s dearest college friend comes to town, and their old competitiveness begins again.
Dr. Mike is nominated for Colorado’s woman of the year.
Medical emergencies keep Dr. Mike from cutting back on her hours in the clinic pending the birth of her baby.
Dr. Mike must choose between her fears of possibly infecting her unborn baby and her desire to help a mysterious stranger carrying a dreaded disease.
Dr. Mike tries to save the life of a young soldier shot during a scuffle between the army and the Indians.
Sully is injured trying to rescue Cloud Dancing from the Army.
Dr. Mike goes into labor in the wilderness, and her baby is born.
Dr. Mike leads a rescue party when Sully and Cloud Dancing are among the passengers in a massive train wreck.
Dr. Mike considers giving up medicine as she tries to cope with being a wife, mother and career woman.

Krystina is welcomed home, following her so-far successful heart transplant; Alexis' affections are pursued by a wealthy real estate baron; convinced he is not a Carrington, Adam's life begins to crumble.
Adam continues to slip further away from Dana and his family, as doubts to his Carrington heritage have their effect; Alexis ends her relationship with Michael Culhane.

Sarah makes a dress for Krystina identical to one worn by her own little girl; concerned over his irrational behavior, Blake hires a private investigator to follow Adam, as his self-destructive quest leads toward disaster.

Steven struggles with his love for Sammy Jo and his homosexuality; despite being warned of Dirk Maurier's questionable business practices, Alexis agrees to a partnership; Leslie and Clay's romance leads to passion.

Krystle and Blake wait helplessly as the police search for Sarah and Krystina; Adam tips Neal McVane to a stock buyout by Alexis and Dirk Maurier; Nick Kimball celebrates his recent good fortune with a marriage proposal to Dominique.

Krystina and Krystle are reunited, as Sarah is placed under private psychiatric care; Adam confesses his true identity to Blake and Alexis; following a visit to his mother's grave, Adam returns to Dana and pleads for her forgiveness.

Blake is stunned to learn that Clay may be Ben's son; Jackie's attempt to reunite Dominique and Garrett fails; Sarah accepts her baby's death after witnessing the gravesite; Clay tells Leslie of their possible blood ties.

Krystle is followed by a mysterious stranger, Clay and Ben plan to leave Denver following the inconclusive blood test to determine Clay's real father; Blake and Alexis show their love for Adam by adopting him legally.
Matthew Blaisdel threatens to kill Blake to ensure Krystle's cooperation; Alexis is saved from certain death by a mysterious and handsome stranger, unaware of their family's horrifying experiences.

Dex is rushed to the hospital while a search party scrambles to locate the missing Carringtons, who are being held captive in a bunkhouse. Fear of the deranged Matthew forces Krystle to pretend that she still has feelings for him.

The incident in the bunkhouse leaves Steven emotionally scarred. The police urge him to seek psychiatric help to deal with the trauma. Jeff and Fallon's unexpected homecoming helps everyone to put the tragedy behind them.

Steven turns down Blake's request to be his campaign manager; Adam is stunned by Dana's inability to bear children; Alexis and Sean Rowan share an intimate afternoon; Blake announces his bid for governor of Colorado, as Alexis plots his downfall.

Sean accepts Alexis' job offer, immediately putting him at odds with Adam; Dana is tortured by a secret from the past explaining her inability to have children; Jeff and Fallon continue to grow farther apart.
Alexis undermines Blake's public opinion with a viperous editorial in her paper; Dana's enthusiasm for a surrogate falters when she suspects Adam finds the other woman more attractive.

A passionate weekend leads Alexis to accept Sean's impulsive marriage proposal; Sammy Jo gives into Josh Harris' passionate advances; celebrating Blake's primary election victory, Adam tells Blake he is going to have another grandchild.

Blake asks Steven to Run Denver-Carrington; Leslie succeeds in seducing Jeff; Sammy Jo struggles with her lingering love for Steven and her passion for Josh, as Josh is consumed by his cocaine addiction.

Alexis schemes to prevent Dana from legally adopting Adam's surrogate child; Adam anonymously informs the press of drug problems on Steven's football team; Steven discovers a powerful secret in Dana's past.
Ghost and Tasha butt heads on how to raise Tariq; Tate gets caught with his pants down; LaKeisha creates new enemies within Tommy's organization; Jason tasks Ghost and Tommy to work together.
The team suddenly realizes that the twin daughters of a murdered couple are missing.
A man who volunteered in South America fails to return home.
The team searches for a young woman who disappeared while on spring break.

Chuck Norris plays a kickboxer hired to help cops after a martial artist starts killing their undercover unit.
Casting takes its toll on everyone as actors drop out, and budgetary concerns affect bookings.
A cannibal attack in a suburban neighborhood forces Seth to bring his team together to save innocent lives.
After being kidnapped by Amaru, Richie wakes up in an abandoned asylum and calls Seth for help.
The team catches a lucky break against Amaru. But nothing is what it seems…
Santanico returns with a new secret - and a potential new ally - leading the Geckos to Lord Venganza.
Maggie Q stars in a video game adaptation where warriors from three legendary clans battle across dimensions.
Mel Gibson plays a therapist to a former assassin who battles mercenaries hunting his family's treasure.
Developed by the military, a massive snake escapes from its pen and stalks the residents of a small town.
A CIA agent races to recover a stolen top-secret weapon: a giant mutant snake.
Jackie Chan stars as a police inspector tracking down a deranged villain who is out to kidnap his daughter.
Jason Statham plays an ex-cage fighter who helps a young girl who holds a secret code.

The Angels assist a man who must learn that he can't control every aspect of his life or the lives of others.
The Angels revisit an old friend hoping to help him realize his vision within the television industry.
The Angels assist a man who has not been able to share a painful secret with his family.
Andrew comes to the rescue of a marriage that is starting off on the wrong foot.
After her mother dies, 10-year-old Danni Blake is determined to find the father she never knew.
When a bomb is planted at a local high school, the Angels must stop it from exploding.
An eternal optimist, with help from the Angels, plans a family vacation for her daughter and son-in-law hopes of strengthening their marriage.
The angels unite to help Reggie, a man who has always considered himself a failure, deal with a secret.

programmes.st: For All The Tea In China
programmes.d: The angels assist a couple that can't have children with the adoption of a Chinese baby girl.
Each angel plays a pivotal role in helping a family deal with the sudden death of a loved one.

programmes.st: A Rock And A Hard Place
programmes.d: The Angels attempt to reunite a father and son before an asteroid destroys planet Earth.
With the help of the Angels, an average man who performs an act of great heroism and gains fleeting fame.
The Angels must band together to combat Monique, Monica's evil twin, and prevent her from breaking up a marriage.
The Angels help a teenage girl who suffers from Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD) and her father overcome their obstacles.

programmes.st: A Feather On The Breath Of God
programmes.d: The Angels help a dying woman try to find a guardian for her daughter.
While the Angels are on an assignment, Tess starts showing the early signs of Alzheimer's Disease.
The Angels come to the aid of a suicidal teen and the radio shock jock who tries to exploit him.
In 1937, a Chinese martial artist returns to Shanghai to find his teacher dead and his school harassed by the Japanese.
After failing to save his wife from 'The Doctor', Kit Li begins working as a bodyguard and secret stunt double for the cowardly martial arts film star Frankie Lane.
Two hitmen, one a novice and the other a veteran with poor luck, band together to find the "King of Killers" for whom there is a large reward.
A Ming Dynasty freedom fighter (Jet Li), a female warrior (Zhou Xun) and a corrupt eunuch (Kun Chen) are among those who converge on a remote desert hostel that sits atop a city of treasures.
In just 3 days, three cases of Smiling Murder shock Hong Kong. The young detective Wang Bu'er and his buddy Huang Feihong embark on an investigation full of excitement and unexpected events.

For many years a mysterious monk with no name (Chow Yun-Fat) has zigzagged the globe to protect an ancient scroll -- a scroll that holds the key to unlimited power. Now the Monk must look for a new scrollkeeper.
A woman reporter discovers a Defense Department project to create androids from the bodies of Vietnamese soldiers, to be then used as an elite anti-terrorism unit.
Max Walker, an officer for a security agency that regulates time travel, must fend for his life against a shady politician who's intent on changing the past to control the future.

'The Inspector's Most Wanted': A criminal from The Inspector's past seeks revenge by having him perform on the all-too-realistic Cop Patrol television show. 'Pinky Appleseed,' Pinky's efforts to re-plant a forest are obstructed by Paul Bunyan.

programmes.st: Calling Dr. Panther/For Those Who Pink
programmes.d: 'Calling Dr. Panther': The Panther must save his Boss from the clutches of a mad doctor. 'For Those Who Pink Young': The Panther gets a child's view of the world when he is accidentally shrunk to kid-size by Professor Von Schmarty's fun machine.

'Lights, Camera, Voodoo': Security guard Panther comes up against an egotistical star, a demented director and an obsessive fan at a movie studio. 'I'm Dreaming of a Pink Christmas': Pinky tries to instill the spirit of Christmas in a 'scrooge.'

'Wiener Takes All': The Panther runs a successful hot dog business until the competition kidnaps the founding granny. 'The Easter Panther': When the Panther is hired to handle the White House Easter Egg Hunt, he must foil a heist by the Dogfather.

Charlie and Itchy step in to break up an argument between two young puppies. Charlie and Itchy hope to help by telling them the story of how the leader of a street dog gang and a quiet unappreciated yard dog became friends.

Charlie wants to be seen as heroic so he can win a reward being offered by a local TV station. Charlie fakes several 'heroic saves' with Itchy, but they all seem to go awry. When he does save Itchy, the reward isn't what he expected.

Hoping to help Itchy conquer some of his fears, Charlie forces him to stay the night in an abandoned mansion. But Itchy discovers that he is not in fact, alone in the home. Two ghosts and a cranky cellar-dweller also are in the mansion.

Charlie is put on Heavenly Trial under the charge of misusing his Miracle Dog Tag. Itchy, coming to Charlie's defense, says Charlie used it selflessly to save a poor old dog, while Carface claims he was being selfish to get free snacks.

After returning from training in heaven, Charlie discovers that Carface has muscled Sasha out of her restaurant. Determined to get Sasha's place back, Charlie and Itchy decide to dress up as southern belles to captivate Carface into confession.
Scott tries to earn money to pay for an electric guitar. He helps at his dad's shop, but finds raising money is a lot more difficult than he expected.
Scott and his family mysteriously become unable to control their wolf-outs and worry that the town monster, that has been covered in recent news reports, is actually them.

Scott's werewolf family comes to town for a family reunion. Scott's cousin, Eva, goes on a date with Mick, and it's Scott's responsibility to protect the family secret before it's revealed that Eva is a werewolf.
Pam's sheepdog, Daisy, gets loose and chases Ballard the cat.  When Mr. Conroy is called to catch Daisy, he bumps into Grandpa, switches glasses with him, and takes him to the pound instead of Daisy.
The Student of the Year winner will be announced soon and Sabrina and Gem are tied to win. Gem uses her money to win the contest so Sabrina uses magic to make Gem lose.
Sabrina, desperate to earn money for an upcoming concert, baby sits the terror twins. Hilda, Zelda and Uncle Quigley warn her that she's just not ready but Sabrina is adamant.

programmes.st: No Time to Be a Hero
programmes.d: Harvey mistakenly thanks Sabrina for saving his life. She feels bad for the unearned praise she is getting. Sabrina, with Salem's help travels back in time to redo everything.
Determined to make Harvey happy, Sabrina dabbles in the spooky jar to make him the raddest skateboarder since Tony Hawk, so he can join a pro team.
Under the influence of a Full Moon, the girls' powers are hugely enhanced and they wreak havoc on Lewis in his boat. The next day the girls realise they still need Lewis.
Emma uses her new powers to help Elliott win at soccer. Lewis decides to test the girls' increased powers. Cleo has had enough of Lewis' smothering and dumps him. Lewis meets Charlotte and they bond.
Zane’s back in town and still in love with Rikki. He works out she’s still a mermaid and tries to win her back. Cleo becomes suspicious of Lewis spending time with Charlotte.
Rikki comes to stay at Emma’s house and stirs up the family unit. In trying to compete with Rikki, Emma tries to rebel and throws a party. Nate uses Lewis to make a play for Cleo.
Gus has an incredible string of good luck culminating in his becoming the captain of the school's Soomer-crosse team. When Cassy becomes jealous of her pal's success.
When Gus and Cassy accidentally sit in Siege Perilous, the legendary throne of Galahad created by Merlin, they begin to return to their magical “roots.”
The ghost of a salty old captain has been regaling Gus with tales of traveling the seas. Consequently, Gus hasn't been studying for his mid-terms.
Verne arrives at his new boarding School in Hamburg for his first day and is horrified to discover that it is filled with all manner of magical beasts and beings!

Lewis finds an old book on mermaids and tests out a potion recipe on the girls. Cleo tries to get Don and her Mum together by using her powers to grant him a wish. Realising it’s not what he wants, she finally accepts the situation.

Cleo is worried when she sees her dad around with another woman. When she arrives at their house, she turns out to be Charlotte's mother. Meanwhile, Rikki and Emma attempt to save the Sertori's dinner with their powers.
Everyone is shocked when Cleo is fired at the Ice Cream Stand, and even more so when Lewis takes her place! Rikki and Emma strike back at him but end up going too far.
Zane has an argument with a man in a trailer park but little does he know it’s Rikki’s dad. Rikki has to overcome her shame about her background and introduce her dad to Zane.
Emma meets Ash - a handsome horse riding instructor. A horse falls ill and Emma must use her powers to fix it. Lewis accidentally invites both Charlotte and Cleo to an awards dinner.
Cleo is failing at school and is assigned a tutor - Charlotte. Cleo wants Lewis back but her attitude to Charlotte only drives him further away. Cleo discovers Lewis and Charlotte kissing.
Marshall worries about his friend who becomes obsessed with heavy metal music to cope with a father who continually berates him.
Marshall is love's reluctant mail carrier when the ghost of a 1920s smitten teen demands that Marshall delivers a love letter to the spirit's dreamgirl, now an elderly woman.
When Frasier leads a protest demanding better treatment of radio station employees, the head honcho at the station's parent company fires them all.
When Frasier appears to be in denial over losing his job, Niles, Roz and Martin join forces to bring him back to reality.
Frasier dreads the idea of attending his high school reunion, which always seems to coincide with a downturn in his life.
Niles isn't too thrilled at the prospect of his father moving in – until he realizes that Daphne is part of the package.
Frasier and Niles will stop at nothing to get tickets to the hottest play in town.
Frasier suspects that his gorgeous new girlfriend is just using him to get free psychiatric advice.
Mistakenly believing he's got a secret admirer, Frasier jeopardizes his new relationship by trying to double his pleasure.
After Maris freezes Niles' assets, he's forced to sublet his luxurious apartment and move into a "low-rent" complex.

programmes.st: The Seal Who Came to Dinner
programmes.d: A dead seal washes up on the beach where Niles throws a gourmet soiree.
Frasier loans Roz $1,500 to tide her over until they get their jobs back, then disapproves of the way she spends the money.
Frasier pretends to be Jewish to placate his new girlfriend's mother.
Frasier is the one who could use some help after his good deeds backfire on him.
Frasier and Roz play matchmakers for their parents – with disastrous results.

programmes.st: The Show Where Woody Shows Up
programmes.d: Cheers' bartender Woody Boyd overstays his welcome when he visits Seattle.
Valentine's Day finds Niles, Frasier, Martin and Daphne on three very different kinds of dates.
Niles hires an aggressive new divorce lawyer who may wind up exposing his long-running crush on Daphne.
Niles secretly schemes to break up Daphne's new romance with his divorce lawyer.
Frasier's plans for an elegant dinner party are thwarted at every turn.
Facing eviction by his snooty tenants' board, Niles throws a party in an effort to get back in their good graces.
The sibling rivalry between Frasier and Niles reaches a fever pitch when they compare IQ scores.
Frasier is horrified when the soft-spoken lady shrink he urged the station to hire turns out to be a tough-talking tyrant.

programmes.st: When a Man Loves Two Women
programmes.d: Frasier's torn between dating his old girlfriend or a voluptuous new flame.
To Niles' delight, a series of psychic visions gives Daphne second thoughts about marrying Donny.
Despondent over Daphne's engagement, Niles takes a walk on the wild side with a funky waitress from Café Nervosa.
The love lives of Frasier, Martin, Niles and Roz come crashing down around them.
Frasier's new girlfriend is loving, attentive—and a dead ringer for his late mother.
Daphne is touched when Frasier agrees to pay for her wedding -- but aghast when he takes control of all the plans.
Frasier vows revenge after a pair of radio "shock jocks" embarrass him in a series of on-air pranks.
Jealous of Niles' position as the arts critic for a snobby magazine, Frasier goes all out in his bid to host a cultural program on his radio station.

programmes.st: The Dog That Rocks the Cradle
programmes.d: Roz hires Bulldog to babysit her daughter, not realizing he's out to bulldoze her social life.
Frasier and Niles crank their sibling rivalry up a notch when each believes the other is trying to steal his girlfriend.
After a family heirloom is linked to the Romanoff's, Frasier and Niles giddily assume they are descended from royalty.
Private Parts follows Howard Stern’s amazing transformation from school nerd to media superstar.
A nice guy goes into the hospital for surgery and through a series of mishaps suffers every man's worst nightmare.

All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, mind you – a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

programmes.st: What to Do on a Date

Lucy's mother wants to join the Ricardos on their road trip out west. As anticipated, Ricky blows his stack when he hears that Lucy's mother wants to go along, and continues to complain that everyone's going on the trip.

When Ricky forbids Lucy from gossiping, she tapes her mouth shut but reveals the latest rumor to Ethel through charades. However, it seems it's the proverbial black pot and kettle when Ricky shares with Fred a spicy tidbit about one of his band members.

programmes.st: Lucy Thinks Ricky has Been Drafted
programmes.d: Lucy opens a telegram addressed to Ricky from the War Department ordering him to appear at the Army's Fort Dix. This letter plus the drills Ricky and Fred have been practicing in the living room convince the women that their husbands have been drafted.

A doting husband and father-to-be, Ricky makes the mistake of giving more attention to the arriving baby than he does to his fickle wife. Ricky tries to please Lucy by making her waffles and he doubles his efforts by giving Lucy baby gifts.

The Ricardos and Mertzes, sightseeing in Paris, are sitting at a sidewalk cafe that Charles Boyer is known to frequent. Lucy thinks she has spotted Boyer and turns to jelly, but Ricky convinces her it's a case of mistaken identity.

Lucy and Ricky, and Fred and Ethel are fed up with each other's annoying habits and decide they all need a break. They split up for a brief vacation and Lucy and Ethel decide they'll go to Palm Springs for a girls-only good time.

Ricky is opening a new night spot, the Club Babalu, and wants Bob Hope to appear at the grand opening. Lucy fears Hope won't because of her widespread reputation for causing chaos, and wants to reassure him that this time she's butting out.

The Ricardos and Mertzes, impatient with their egg selling business, decide that they must trade in their 500 chicks for 200 egg laying hens. However, after a couple of weeks, these hens don't yield many eggs at all.

Lucy must get vacationing Ricky out of her hair so she can do her housework. She and Ethel trick their husbands into building a brick barbecue on the Ricardo patio by first pretending to build it themselves.

Lucy decides Ricky's love is growing cold so she takes Ethel's advice she learned from a book, How to Keep the Honeymoon from Ending. Her attempt to dress up for breakfast doesn't yield any response from Ricky.

Ricky is the emcee for a television variety show and Lucy wants to appear in one of its commercials. To prove to her husband that she has screen presence, she removes the inner parts of their TV set, gets into it, and does a commercial as he arrives home.

The Tropicana club is about to re-open under new management and is looking to Ricky to put on the best possible show. The only problem is that Ricky has come down with a terrible case of laryngitis, and is unable to talk, much less sing.

Lucy arrives in Hollywood with Little Ricky to meet her husband and his new press agent, who intends on making Ricky the "Cuban Liberace." Charlie Pomerantz plans a publicity stunt he hopes will get Ricky into Hedda Hopper's gossip column.
Lucy and Ricky's thirteenth anniversary is rapidly approaching. In an outward show of affection, they buy each other gifts—golf clubs for Ricky and fur for Lucy.

Lucy Ricardo meets her Spanish-speaking mother-in-law for the first time and her efforts to be a gracious host turn disastrous. Lucy's inability to speak Spanish and her in-law's inability to understand Lucy's pantomime erects a wall of misunderstanding.

After five weeks on the road driving across the country, the Ricardos and the Mertzes arrive at their destination – Hollywood. With stars in her eyes, Lucy heads for the Brown Derby, a restaurant frequented by celebrities, with Ethel and Fred in tow.

Lucy and Ricky, and Fred and Ethel are fed up with each other's annoying habits and decide they all need a break. They split up for a brief vacation and Lucy and Ethel decide they'll go to Palm Springs for a girls-only good time.

Lucy and Ethel are eager to get a closer look at the belongings of the O'Briens, new neighbors in the building. They snoop around in their apartment while they are away and when they hear the O'Briens return, Lucy is trapped in the closet.

Fred and Ethel overhear a fight between Ricky and Lucy...or did they? It seems Lucy is reading a murder mystery out loud to the amusement of Ricky. But when Ricky playfully throws the book at Lucy, she ends up with a black eye.

Lucy decides to take part in the fund-raising campaign of the Westport Historical Society and offers to get her husband and his band to perform for their kickoff function. There's only one hitch – Ricky refuses to do it.

A magazine test has gotten Lucy into a tizzy. Lucy and Ricky take a test called "How to Rate Your Marriage." One of the questions in the quiz asks about old flames. When Lucy rattles off a list of old boyfriends, Ricky feels the need to compare.

Lucy is desperate to appear in a Hollywood movie after hearing the Mertzes have bit parts in an upcoming feature. She sets out to be "discovered" and lands a part in an MGM musical. She plays a showgirl in a glamorous nightclub scene but has some trouble.
Mario, the Ricardos' and Mertzes' gondolier in Venice, comes to New York to surprise his brother, but turns up at the Ricardos' apartment when he can't find him.

After the Mertzes have a quarrel the Ricardos try their best to get them back together. Lucy invites each of them to dinner without the other knowing. The Mertzes finally reconcile but in the process, the Ricardos squabble.
The Ricardos and Mertzes are out a restaurant and Lucy keeps changing her order and their seating. Ricky points out that she constantly changes her mind and never completes things.

Not feeling well, Lucy takes herself to the doctor and receives the happy news that she is pregnant. Ethel and Fred find out before Ricky and eagerly begin dreaming about being the lucky godparents. Getting the news to Ricky is not as easy.

For the Mertzes' twenty-fifth wedding anniversary, Lucy and Ricky present them with a television set. As they are watching it, Ricky's constant adjustments cause the set to explode. Fred gets even by kicking in the Ricardos' TV set.

programmes.d: The annual talent show for the Wednesday Afternoon Fine Arts League is going to be televised this year, and Lucy and Ethel are going to perform a duet. Everything is going well as Lucy gets Ricky to emcee the show and help her and Ethel prepare.

When Ricky forbids Lucy from gossiping, she tapes her mouth shut but reveals the latest rumor to Ethel through charades. However, it seems it's the proverbial black pot and kettle when Ricky shares with Fred a spicy tidbit about one of his band members.

Lucy Ricardo meets her Spanish-speaking mother-in-law for the first time and her efforts to be a gracious host turn disastrous. Lucy's inability to speak Spanish and her in-law's inability to understand Lucy's pantomime erects a wall of misunderstanding.
The six remaining artists work in an assembly line for an American traditional-style Elimination Tattoo, and the artists must put one of their teammates up for elimination.
The pressure is on when the artists must ink the ultimate in-your-face tattoo, and regretful canvases task the artists with covering up symbols of hate.
The tables are turned when the new artists call the shots in the Elimination Tattoo, and the battle for a spot in the finale is more intense than ever.
The master canvases are revealed, and America helps crown a new Ink Master.
The cutthroat battle for $100,000 and the title of Ink Master kicks off as 30 artists vie for one of 18 spots on Oliver Peck and Chris Nunez's teams.
Team Peck and Team Nunez work together in an intense Flash Challenge, and the losing team must compete among themselves in the Elimination Tattoo.
Team Nunez is out for revenge in the Flash Challenge, and an artist betrays one of his teammates in Team Peck's Elimination Tattoo.
The pressure is on when both Team Peck and Team Nunez must work in pairs to transform their canvases into warriors in the Elimination Tattoo.
Team Nunez uses live wires to create art pieces in an electrifying Flash Challenge, and a gendered alliance has the women out for blood.
Team Peck fights for control of the game in a Flash Challenge testing contrast, and one artist turns the tables on the women's alliance.
The artists must tattoo former smokers who have been scarred for life, and the six remaining artists on Team Nunez battle for a spot in the team's top five.
The artists are tasked with manipulating metal in the Flash Challenge, and the six remaining artists on Team Peck vie for a spot in the team's top five.
The artists must ink their canvases' heads in an intense two-day long Elimination Tattoo, and the battle between alliances heats up.

programmes.st: Like Sand Through the Hour Glass
programmes.d: Team Peck and Team Nunez face off to create custom designs for muscle cars, the artists ink hourglass tattoos on their canvases, and NFL player Von Miller is a guest judge.
One artist cracks under the pressure after an intense Flash Challenge, the artists must cover up lower back tattoos, and tattoo artist Robert Atkinson is a guest judge.
Dave takes a deep dive into the lives and strategies of the final six artists with never-before-seen footage from the season.
Mt. Hakurei gets stronger, and Kikyo is prevented from going into its hold ground.
Suikotsu cannot kill Chiyo and the others. Jakotsu stops him. He senses an attack from Sesshomaru.

programmes.st: Vanished in a River of Flames
programmes.d: Ginkotsu has died, and Renkotsu uses his shard without permission. In doing so, he has betrayed Bankotsu. He cannot go back anymore.

programmes.st: Into the Depths of Mt. Hakurei
programmes.d: The evil within Mt. Hakurei is Naraku's demons and Kagura. Miroku risks his life to save Sango, by opening his Wind Tunnel and sucking in the demons.
Miroku and Sango come face to face with the Saint Hakushin's mummy on Mt. Hakurei. The saint tells them his reason for helping Naraku.
Inuyasha regains his demon powers. He defeats Jakotsu, and hurries to Mt. Hakurei. Renkotsu has rebellious feelings towards Bankotsu.

programmes.st: Final Battle: The Last and Strongest of the Band of Seven
programmes.d: Mt. Hakurei's barrier disappears. Inuyasha is worried about Kagome. Kagome heads to Mt. Hakurei with Koga and the others.

programmes.st: The Power of Banryu: Duel to the Death on Mt. Hakurei
programmes.d: Miroku and Sango see a mysterious lump of flesh in the depths of Mt. Hakurei.
Naraku has gained a new body and has been reborn.
Mt. Hakurei is destroyed. Koga falls to the bottom of it. Inuyasha saves him.
Inuyasha is pulled away from his friends when he is tricked by fake information that Kikyo is still alive.
Naraku's baby carries Kagome to an abandoned temple. He orders Kagura to place a corrupt Sacred Jewel shard in her.

programmes.st: Don't Boil It! The Terrifying Dried-Up Demon!
programmes.d: In feudal Japan, Naraku has sent a demon called Mimisenri to look for the Sacred Jewel shards.

programmes.st: Battle Against the Dried-Up Demons at the Cultural Festival!
programmes.d: On the day of the cultural festival, the dried demons that Kagome brought from feudal Japan are revived. They devour the food that Yuka and the others made.
A demon named Chokyukai is revived, and begins to steal girls. A young man named Kisuke comes to Kaede for help. Inuyasha go to defeat the demon.

programmes.st: Shippo's New Technique, The Heart Scar!
programmes.d: Five demon fox brothers believe Shippo to be a hero. They become his disciples to learn his special technique, the Wind Scar.

programmes.st: Trap of The Cursed Wall Hanging
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang meet Shinosuke, who is looking for his fiancée. They are led to a village of only women, and are separated by sex into their rooms.
At a village where only women live, a demon that was sealed away in a hanging scroll at Kanondo is revived.

programmes.st: The Woman Who Loved Sesshomaru, Part 1
programmes.d: Sara, a mysterious woman, appears before Sara. Sara was once saved by Sesshomaru. She was reincarnated just as she had died from an illness.

programmes.st: The Woman Who Loved Sesshomaru, Part 2
programmes.d: Sara asks Sesshomaru to destroy her along with the spirit. Sesshomaru complies, and uses the Tessaiga to destroy Sara along with the spirit.

programmes.st: The Last Banquet of Miroku's Master
programmes.d: Priest Mushin, the person who raised Miroku, is going to die. Miroku and the others are shocked.
A treasure stealing invisible demon appears. An old lady who failed to defeat him asks Inuyasha and the gang for help.
Akitoki, Hoji's ancestor is on a journey to offer the Hojo family heirloom, the Kenkon Naginata, a demon sword that brings disaster.

programmes.st: Mountain of Demons: Survival of the Duo
programmes.d: Akitoki and Inuyasha travel the shrine of the wind and thunder gods to make an offering to seal away the blade's demon powers.

programmes.st: The Great Duel at Shoun Falls!
programmes.d: Hoshiyomi uses the Kon blade to steal the Tessaiga's demon powers.

programmes.st: Eternal Love: The Naginata of Kenkon
programmes.d: Tsukiyomi, who is supposed to be dead, possesses Kagome and appears before Hoshiyomi.
Naraku's baby is bringing virtuous priests close to death and peering into their minds. He is trying to peer into the space between this world and the next.
Naraku's baby was split into two. One half comes back to life in the form of a child dressed in white.
Kanta is an otter demon child. His father's head was taken by Hakudoshi, and he is looking for his father's body.
The area between this world and the next, where Sacred Jewel shard is, is the demon graveyard where Inuyasha's father's corpse rests.

programmes.st: Bizarre Guards at the Border of the Afterlife
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang arrive in the land of fire. They discover a giant gateway within a cave in the mountains.

programmes.st: The Fiery Bird Master, Princess Abi
programmes.d: When the gateway in the Land of Fire opened, Kagome sensed the presence of the Sacred Jewel shard.
In addition to being overwhelmed with all the wedding planning, Jane begins to feel guilty about her emerging feelings towards Rafael and decides to tell Michael during their pre-wedding counseling.
Furious at her mother Xo, Jane decides she needs some space and moves in with her fiancée, Michael. However, living together isn't what she thought it would be and Jane has to rethink her plans.
Jane and Rogelio begin to grow closer until she meets his mean twin teenage stepdaughters, who are determined to make her life miserable.
Jane decides the best thing for her is to stay away from Rafael, but when her friends insist on taking her to the hot new club that he owns, she finds it hard to avoid him.

Jane and Rafael both reveal shocking secrets to each other.  Xo is excited when a music producer, Elliot, contacts her to record a demo, but little does she know that Rogelio had a hand in making it happen.

Jane and Rafael are both concerned about Petra's true intentions with the baby, especially after they discover one of her shocking secrets. Rogelio is nominated again for a Best Actor award and invites Jane, Alba and Xo to attend the show with him.
As a hurricane rips through Miami, Jane is forced to stay at the Marbella, but the storm soon becomes the least of her concerns.
When the nuns surprise Jane by offering her a permanent teaching position, she's excited, but things become complicated when Rogelio offers Jane a writing internship at his telenovela.

Jane gets a big break in her career, but it all seems too good to be true, especially when it involves Rogelio.  Rafael is stressed about Sin Rostro's connection to the hotel and begins to fear for his family's safety.

Jane and Rafael are excited to find out the sex of the baby, but a medical issue means Jane might miss her graduation.  Xo notices that something is going on with her mother, Alba, but Alba is too embarrassed to talk about it.
Michael is convinced that Rafael is helping to hide his father and puts the thought into Jane's head as well, making her grow suspicious of Rafael's recent actions.
When Jane and Rafael receive news about their baby's health, they revisit moving in together which prompts a surprise from Rafael.

Jane is feeling distant from Rafael so she focuses on her writing instead, but is stuck with a case of writers block. When Jane runs into Michael he mentions a romance writing workshop, and she thinks she has found the solution.

When a crisis with the hotel overwhelms Rafael, Jane becomes concerned that he might not be as hands-on in fatherhood as she expected. Alba is having a difficult time with Xo's living situation which causes a strain between them.
Jane unintentionally ruins Rafael's chances of getting the hotel's liquor license back, but her attempt to help fix it means missing the Villanueva's Easter festivities.

Jane is desperate to fix things with Rafael and suggests working on a way to help them move past their problems.  Xo has been keeping a secret from Rogelio, but when she finally comes clean to him, Rogelio's reaction surprises her.

Jane is determined to do what's best for the baby, especially after she and Rafael learn that the baby is breech.  Xo (Andrea Navedo) continues to try to apologize to Rogelio, but faces an uphill battle.
